'''Nick Fehring''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 53rd at [[2000 Texas State Championship]] on 6 May 2000, according to Brian Guthrie's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d692">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-08-tx-state-championship-director-s-reportd692/ tx-state-championship-director-s-report], DeckTech (Brian "Red 81" Guthrie, 8 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-08-tx-state-championship-director-s-reportd692/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
